title: Minnesota District 2

bio.title: Matt Little
bio.bio: Matthew Martin Little is an American attorney and politician and a former member of the Minnesota Senate. A member of the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL), he represented District 58 in the southern Twin Cities metropolitan area from 2017 to 2021.

bio.title: Eric Pratt
bio.bio: Eric R. Pratt is a Minnesota politician and member of the Minnesota Senate. A member of the Republican Party of Minnesota, he represents District 54 in the southwestern Twin Cities metropolitan area.
